sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: The Wall Around the Roots

levels.entry: The wall is cracked beside the neem.
The oldest cracks are dry. New plaster stops short of the living roots.
At noon the shaded jars stay cool. The tree is doing work the courtyard needs.
The mason can repair the loose upper course without cutting the roots. A wall can be kept without making the courtyard bare.
